title: eRUBY rice: Co-expression of a feedback-insensitive TyrA arogenate dehydrogenase with RUBY enhances endosperm betalain levels
content: eRUBY is a powerful visual reporter combining a feedback-insensitive TyrA arogenate dehydrogenase (ADHα) gene with original RUBY structure, and substantially promotes betalain biosynthesis in rice endosperm.
